title: Target’s Discovery Day Helps Brand Founders Grow While Fueling What’s Next for Guests
summary: Learn more about Target's Discovery Day and how we're building relationships with the next generation of brand founders.
body_markdown:
Over the years, we've helped many founder-led brands and emerging businesses grow into household names, while giving guests access to innovative products and brands. From national brands to regional favorites scaling to broader audiences, these partnerships reflect Target's merchandising authority in action: curating a distinctive assortment that combines innovation, cultural relevance and discovery to create a shopping experience only Target can deliver.


One of the ways we're building relationships with the next generation of founders and identifying innovative products that could become guests' favorite discoveries is through Target Discovery Day events.


### What is Target Discovery Day?


Discovery Day brings together founders and Target buyers and leaders to build relationships, share insights and explore future business opportunities. Discovery Days are held across multiple categories throughout the year and are designed to help Target identify emerging brands and product innovation while supporting entrepreneurs at various stages of growth.


At our recent Essentials & Beauty Discovery Day, more than 80 beauty, wellness, baby, pet and personal care founders from across the U.S. and Canada gathered at Target headquarters in Minneapolis.


The day included educational sessions, founder networking, one-on-one meetings with buyers, a panel discussion featuring founders whose brands have grown at Target, and a brand showcase where more than 200 Target team members met founders and experienced products firsthand.


> Hearing the stories from founders on today's panel was so inspiring and helpful. Hearing them talk about taking it slow, and that Target is here to support and help, feels different from anything I've experienced.
>
>
> Sophia Wojczak
>
>
> Discovery Day participant and founder of Arachne


Photo by Stephen Allen


### How does Discovery Day help founders?


For many brand founders, a highlight of Discovery Day was their one-on-one meeting with a Target buyer. The founders introduced their brand and products, and the buyers provided real-time feedback, explained what they look for when evaluating products, what it takes to grow in mass retail and more.


> Just getting to be face to face with a buyer and pitch your product and your brand is amazing. Instead of another upload or application, you're able to have a real conversation. Even if this isn't the meeting that gets us on Target shelves, it's one of a series of meetings that could eventually get us there. If the outcome is learning what we need to work on or how we need to grow, that's incredibly valuable.
>
>
> Carrie Sporer & Meredith Krill
>
>
> Discovery Day participants and founders of SWAIR haircare


That relationship-first approach is what makes Discovery Day unique. The goal isn't simply to identify brands for today. It's to build connections that can continue long after the event ends, whether founders are ready for retail now or still building toward that goal.


> We've already gotten valuable feedback around packaging, storytelling and how to stand out on shelf. We talked about how the product itself can communicate the story and how it needs to show up alongside other brands. Those conversations have been really helpful.
>
>
> Shan Berries
>
>
> Discovery Day participant and founder of Shades by Shan


Photo by Stephen Allen


### How does Discovery Day help Target identify emerging brands and trends?


While Discovery Day supports founders, it also helps Target identify what's next. Target buyers are constantly looking for emerging trends, innovative products and brands that can help meet evolving guest needs. At Discovery Day, our buyers engage directly with founders to understand the inspiration behind their businesses and explore how their products might fit into Target's assortment.


> I loved attending Discovery Day and having the opportunity to meet with founders in one space. It was encouraging to see these founders meeting and sharing their collective experience to empower each other, as well.
>
>
> Mariam Kocharian
>
>
> Cosmetics Merchandising Director, Target


Meeting founders directly gives buyers an opportunity to evaluate not only the product itself, but also the vision, consumer connection and long-term potential behind the brand.


The result is valuable for everyone involved: Founders gain access to expertise, feedback and relationships that can help accelerate their businesses, and is one of many ways Target gains insight into the emerging brands, products and trends that could shape the future of Target’s assortment.


Photo by Stephen Allen


### How is Target creating a pipeline for what’s next?


Additional Discovery Day events are planned throughout the year. And while each Discovery Day lasts only a day, the conversations it sparks have the potential to shape the future of both emerging brands and the products guests discover at Target.


*Photography by Stephen Allen*
